integrity: The proof uses the published residue-coset decomposition of the total graph and an explicit classification of paired dominating sets in clique and complete-bipartite components. Exhaustive checks on Z/4Z, Z/8Z, and Z/9Z are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite commutative local nonfields.
The polynomial reconstructs the total graph parameters q and s, not the ring isomorphism type.
Fields have no paired dominating set in their total graph, so the reconstruction theorem excludes them.
title: Paired-domination polynomials reconstruct finite local total graphs
